item.title: A FASTA record begins with a definition line starting with `>`
item.content: In FASTA, each sequence record starts with a definition/header line whose first character is `>`, followed by an identifier and optional descriptive information, then one or more sequence lines.
item.explanationMarkdown: The leading `>` distinguishes the header from the biological sequence. Multiple FASTA records are represented by repeating this header-plus-sequence structure.
